summary: Regression pass for the N+1 → batched-lookup fix on GET /api/leads and dashboard_home enrich. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_leads_perf_fix.py with 10 pytest cases — ALL 10 PASSED (basic shape+speed, real seller_name present, real vehicle_label present, pagination page1/page2 disjoint, status filter, score_band filter, qualification_status filter, sort orders newest/oldest/highest_score/lowest_score/recent_activity, search by seller name, search by vehicle label, dashboard_home shape + enrichment). /api/leads returns in ~ sub-second against local Mongo, response schema {items,total,page,page_size} correct with page_size default 25. Frontend (Playwright on public preview URL): logged in as admin@autoacquire.ai, /app/leads renders the leads table with 50 rows (NOT stuck on 'Loading…'), 'Search seller, vehicle, phone...' input filters live (typing 'Unknown' narrowed to 31 rows and header updated to '31 total leads'), /app/dashboard renders Hot leads (Steven Wilson / 2020 Honda CR-V, Emily Tremblay / 2019 Kia Forte, Amanda Nguyen / 2020 Chevrolet Traverse, Maria Chen / 2022 Jeep Wrangler, Jessica Cote / 2014 Kia Sportage), Needs review, and New leads cards — confirming batched seller+vehicle enrichment still produces correct seller_name and vehicle_label values.
critical_code_review_comments: list_leads: pagination is applied AFTER the in-Python 'search' filter, so 'total' correctly reflects the filtered set — good. However .to_list(2000) still fetches up to 2000 leads per request from Mongo before filtering; if a large org grows past 2000 the tail will be silently truncated. Consider paginating in the DB query (using $or search across joined seller/vehicle fields) once orgs exceed a few hundred leads.
list_leads/dashboard enrich: search is case-insensitive on name/vehicle_label/phone/email but does not strip whitespace or handle partial phone digits — minor UX gap but not a regression.

dashboard_home: today_appointments filter uses (a.get('start_time') or '').startswith(today) — works because timestamps are ISO with UTC, but if start_time is ever stored as a datetime object rather than a string, this would return an empty list silently. Consider normalizing type.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Leads renders 50 rows, search works, Dashboard renders enriched cards)

seed_data_creation: None — used existing 'prestige-auto-toronto' seeded org (~50 leads).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Perf fix verified. Regression suites now available: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py, test_auth_google_regression.py, test_gemini_public_chat.py, test_leads_perf_fix.py. Note that on the preview env Mongo is local so timing does NOT reflect Atlas; correctness of batched $in lookups is the real signal and it is intact.
rca of the issue: Prior N+1 (3 sequential per-lead find_one calls in list_leads and dashboard_home enrich) has been replaced by three batched $in queries against sellers/seller_vehicles/appointments. Regression tests confirm seller_name and vehicle_label are still populated correctly, filters/sort/search/pagination still work, and the Leads page no longer hangs on 'Loading…'. No behavioral drift observed.
